# iNeedWorkwear

> Independent UK workwear guidance — safety standards decoded in plain English, kit lists by sector and role, and care guides that keep certified garments compliant. The companion shop is at https://www.ineedworkwear.com. Phone 01597 730142 · hello@ineedworkwear.com.

Facts on this site are checked against the published EN/ISO standards they describe; each page names the specific classes and test values so claims can be verified.
